text:
Professional doctor and friendly team!
After I moved to Thailand, here is always taking care of my health. Greatly appreciate that!

I came to get my vaccine the other day. The service was great and very fast. I came to the clinic, registered briefly, and got my injection right away. Then I sat and waited for 15 minutes to be observed. The nurse was very gentle; it didn't hurt at all.

The admin's response via LINE chat is terrible. I've been ordering medication from them for a year. Let me explain: I work as a sex worker abroad. Today I messaged them to order medication, mentioning that I had recently had a blood test but didn't have the results. They also suggested ordering a blood test kit if I ordered a large quantity. So I reluctantly did. When I asked for delivery via Grab, they claimed they couldn't see the delivery address and then said, "You're not taking it yourself, are you? You're going to sell it, so I won't sell it to you." I've always used it myself, and they responded so rudely. I'm very disappointed.

Good and fast service. I had an appointment and was able to get the injection immediately; no long wait. The doctor explained the brand and properties of the vaccine. I waited 15 minutes while they monitored my condition.
